subtitle: Risk bands replace fixed HP thresholds
synopsis: VariableDamage is harder because incoming damage is uncertain. S3-RISK replaces the FixedDamage HP rule with risk bands. In this replay, FlashLite-S3-RISK manages that uncertainty by healing before the endgame becomes lethal, while FlashLite-S0-AO reacts too late and runs out of resources. This is the transfer story: the stack structure carries over, but the grounding has to match the game.
